[FACT] User is looking for recommendations on cashback apps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cashback apps are a great way to earn rewards on everyday purchases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cashback apps include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Rakuten (formerly known as Ebates): Cashback at over 2,500 stores, including Amazon, Walmart, and Sephora; up to 40% cashback at certain stores; $10 sign-up bonus; payable by check or PayPal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Ibotta: Cashback on groceries, gas, and other purchases; average cashback rate: 2-5%; $20 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal, Venmo, or gift cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Fetch Rewards: Cashback on gas, groceries, and dining purchases; average cashback rate: 2-5%; $2 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal or gift cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Drop: Cashback on purchases at popular brands like Starbucks, Amazon, and Uber; average cashback rate: 1-5%; $10 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal or gift cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Dosh: Cashback on purchases at thousands of stores, including restaurants and travel bookings; average cashback rate: 2-10%; $10 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal or bank transfer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Checkout 51: Cashback on groceries and gas purchases; average cashback rate: 2-5%; $10 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal or check.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. CoinOut: Cashback on purchases at popular retailers like Amazon, Walmart, and Target; average cashback rate: 2-5%; $5 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal or gift cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. TopCashback: Cashback at over 3,000 stores, including Amazon and eBay; average cashback rate: 2-10%; $10 sign-up bonus; payable via PayPal, bank transfer, or gift cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When choosing a cashback app, consider factors like stores you frequently shop at, cashback rates, sign-up bonuses, minimum payout thresholds, and user reviews.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cashback apps are meant to be a supplement to regular shopping habits, not a way to make a living.
